capabilities: Sync Pocket recordings, transcripts, summaries, action items, mind maps, and translations into vault notes
Filter which recordings sync by folder, tag, and date horizon
Organize notes with base folders, date folders, and name templates
Configure auto-sync intervals per device and run sync from the ribbon or command palette
Protect user edits with owned note regions, frozen notes, and marked-not-deleted statuses
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder; it imports recordings made in the Pocket app into your vault as notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The API key is stored in Obsidian's secret storage rather than the plugin's data.json. Sync is one-way; the plugin never writes to Pocket or deletes notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import recordings and their AI-generated transcripts, summaries, and action items from the Pocket app.
summary: Syncs Pocket app recordings into your vault as Markdown notes with transcripts, summaries, action items, mind maps, and translations.
